map.输入自身与若干竞品的播放量，工具计算竞品均值与中位数作为对标水位，得出自身相对差: Enter the play counts of yourself and several competitors; the tool computes the competitor mean and median as the benchmark level, derives your relative gap rate ((yourself − mean) ÷ mean × 100%), and classifies accounts into head / waist / long-tail by 1.5× and 0.7× the mean. Like rate and completion rate help judge content quality; the benchmarking conclusions are for topic selection and differentiation strategy reference only.

map.算例（8 家竞品月活，单位万：120,150,90,200,80,160,110: Worked example (8 competitors' monthly active users, unit 10 thousand: 120,150,90,200,80,160,110,95)
map.数据量 n=8，总和=1005，均值=1005÷8≈125.6 万；排序后 80: Data size n=8, sum=1005, mean=1005÷8≈125.6 (in 10 thousand); sorted 80,90,95,110,120,150,160,200, median=(110+120)÷2=115 (in 10 thousand); variance≈(sum of squared differences from the mean)÷8≈1484.0, standard deviation≈38.5 (in 10 thousand); range=200−80=120 (in 10 thousand). Interpretation: the mean of 125.6 is slightly higher than the median of 115, meaning the head (200) pulls the average up and the market is right-skewed; the standard deviation of 38.5 is about 30.7% of the mean, a moderate dispersion. The tool outputs each step in the order data size → sum → mean → median → min/max → range → variance → standard deviation.
map.均值和中位数哪个更可信？: Which is more reliable, the mean or the median?
map.均值对极端值敏感，有头部超大样本时会虚高（如上例 200 万）；中位数不受极值影: The mean is sensitive to extreme values and becomes inflated when there is a very large head sample (such as 200 above); the median is unaffected by extremes and better represents the "typical level". This tool gives both; when outliers are obvious it is recommended to rely mainly on the median.
map.标准差到底代表什么？: What does the standard deviation actually represent?
map.标准差衡量数据的离散/波动程度，越大说明样本越分散、越不整齐。对标分析中，标准差: The standard deviation measures how dispersed / volatile the data is; the larger it is, the more scattered and uneven the samples. In benchmarking, a large standard deviation means big differences across players and room to find a differentiation angle; a small one means the market is converging and you must break through via operations or experience. It complements the range: the range shows the span between the two ends, the standard deviation shows the overall spread.
